decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity runs on owned fibre, fits the high-bandwidth, software-defined direction and serves growing cloud and data centre demand, so the option is still worth holding at low cost.
The self-service number ordering portal supports the voice business and the real-time provisioning strategy at little marginal cost, so there is no evidence yet that justifies abandoning it.

Carrier pre-selection depends on legacy switched telephony that is being phased out as German networks move to all-IP, so its value is unlikely to be realized and its resources are better shifted to growth services.
Direct IP voice connections are central to enterprise voice after the move to all-IP and are cheap to run on the owned network, so the product should be kept.
